raw_text: URGENT: NSCN-IM ceasefire agreement on verge of collapse. Central government has failed to deliver on Framework Agreement promises. Naga tribal bodies calling for total shutdown across Dimapur, Kohima, Mon, and Tuensang districts starting tomorrow. All community members must participate. Road blockades to be set up at all major intersections.
clean_text: NSCN-IM ceasefire agreement reportedly on verge of collapse. Naga tribal bodies calling for total shutdown across Dimapur, Kohima, Mon, and Tuensang districts with road blockades.
